enrichment.core_claim: An immersive audiovisual quantum RNG platform tests whether absorbed attention produces random bursts; exploratory signals motivate a sealed confirmatory study including an LLM operator.
enrichment.ask_question: What will you conclude if the LLM operator produces the same burst signature as human participants?
enrichment.challenge_question: With aggregate nulls and exploratory windows, how will the sealed study guard against the flexibility that produced earlier positive contrasts?
